name: Fenrir (Paper Trading)
tagline: Runs a paper-trading tournament on NSE or NASDAQ

source.excerpt: Shared as a paper-trading tournament of competing strategies on a live feed.

body:
## What it does

Orchestrates competing strategies against a live market feed as a tournament, retargeting the clock, currency and universe depending on which exchange you point it at. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @shantanugoel shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
